title: UserGroup.Attributes
description:
Attributes that describe a user group resource.

Introduced in Apple Business API 2.6.

createdDateTime.description: The date and time the user group was created.

name.description: The name of the user group.

ouId.description: The identifier of the organizational unit the group belongs to.

status.description: The status of the group. See [UserGroupStatus](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/applebusinessapi/usergroupstatus) for possible values.

totalMemberCount.description: The total number of members in the group.

type.description: The type of group. See [UserGroupType](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/applebusinessapi/usergrouptype) for possible values.

updatedDateTime.description: The date and time the user group was last modified.
